title: 第7章 至阴之物第8章 鲸杀拳馆
slug: 从衔尾蛇石碑开始超凡
lines: 看着面前的进货单，林野脸上露出笑容。
怪不得之前就觉得有些眼熟，这20株黑螺形草所在的那一批货，当时还是原身负责和仓库交接的。
只不过校实验室购买的黑螺形草都是风干后的，模样上有差距。
再加上那一批货量很大，所以一时间才没有记起来。
只是这东西居然这么值钱吗？
一株就要400，比很多人参的价格都要高了吧？
看向单子上的药材介绍，黑螺形草，喜生山阴松树下，主治肾精不生，髓血亏空。
‘黑山羊之夜的效果中，有一条是少量永久性提升服用者的力气和灵活性，这么看，确实对应上了。’
拿起手机，打开超信，找到‘庄师’，这是原身大学导师。
大三开学被导师看中，可以预见的是大四也会在庄师手底下学习了。
这里的大学没有‘考’研一说，全在导师选择。
如果没有导师看上收作学生，成绩再好也没用，大四毕业之后就要走向社会。
而绝大部分学生，一整个大学时期都没有导师看中，只能选择直接毕业。
没有导师的推荐信，其实也很难进入比较顶尖的企业。
毕竟，现在的大学生数量相比从前其实增长了很多。
但总体来说，大学生还是属于高级人才行列。
原身也算是运气好，被导师看中了。
“老师，您这里还有黑螺形草吗？”
发过信息之后，他把进货单收好，连同文件夹都放回去。
不等关上抽屉，手机传来震动声，急忙回头看过去。
【庄师】：“有，怎么了？”
林野面色一喜，直接打字回复，“老师，我想买三株，可以吗？”
虽然配方只需要一株，但一次未必能够成功。
【庄师】：“你要这东西？做什么用？”
“我养了条狗，最近身子骨有些弱。之前看到黑螺形草的介绍上有这方面的作用，所以想买一些给它吃，看看有没有效果。”
发完消息后，对面陷入了沉寂，过了近五分钟才回复消息。
【庄师】：“行，效果应该还是不错的。那你明天到实验楼仓库来领，记我账上就行了。不过我记得好像就只有一株了，开学前应该不会再进货了。”
“麻烦老师了。”
【庄师】：“那行，拿完之后到我办公室来一趟，刚好有些事找你。”
看到‘办公室’三个字，林野忍不住深吸一口凉气，没来由地有些紧张。
“好的，老师。”
关闭超信，再次打开购物平台，搜索‘白锡粉末’。
没多久，林野看着手机屏幕上的图片皱起眉头。
‘银色的白锡粉末？’
‘没记错的话，正常的白锡粉末应该是灰白色吧？’
content_en:
Looking at the purchase order in front of him, Lin Ye had a smile on his face.
No wonder it looked familiar to me before. The batch of goods containing these 20 black spiral grasses was the one I was responsible for handing over to the warehouse at that time.
However, the black spiral grass purchased in the school laboratory is all dried, and there is a difference in appearance.
In addition, the batch was very large, so I didn’t remember it for a while.
But is this thing actually so valuable?
One plant costs 400, which is higher than the price of many ginsengs, right?
Looking at the medicinal materials on the list, Black Spiral Grass grows under the pine trees in Shanyin. It is mainly used to treat insufficiency of kidney essence and marrow blood deficiency.
‘One of the effects of Black Goat Night is that a small amount permanently improves the strength and flexibility of the user. From this point of view, it does correspond. ’
Pick up your phone, open Chaoxin, and find ‘Master Zhuang’, who is your original university tutor.
At the beginning of his junior year, he was favored by his tutor. It is foreseeable that he will also study under Master Zhuang in his senior year.
There is no "postgraduate entrance examination" in the universities here, it's all up to the tutor's choice.
If there is no tutor who likes you as a student, it will be useless no matter how good your grades are. After graduating from senior year, you will have to enter the society.
The vast majority of students have not been favored by their tutors throughout their college years and have no choice but to graduate directly.
Without a recommendation letter from a mentor, it is actually difficult to enter a relatively top company.
After all, the number of college students now has actually increased a lot compared to before.
But generally speaking, college students still belong to the ranks of high-level talents.
The original person was lucky enough to be chosen by his mentor.
"Teacher, do you still have black spiral grass here?"
After sending the message, he put the purchase order away and put the folder back together.
Before I could close the drawer, my phone vibrated, and I hurriedly looked back.
[Master Zhuang]: "Yes, what's wrong?"
Lin Ye looked happy and typed a reply directly, "Teacher, I want to buy three plants, is that okay?"
Although the recipe only requires one plant, it may not be successful at the first try.
[Master Zhuang]: "You want this thing? What is it for?"
"I have a dog, and his body bones have been a little weak recently. I saw that black spiral grass has this effect on the introduction, so I want to buy some for it to eat to see if it has any effect."
After sending the message, the other party fell into silence, and it took nearly five minutes for the message to be replied.
[Master Zhuang]: "Okay, the effect should be pretty good. Then you can pick it up at the experimental building warehouse tomorrow and charge it to my account. But I remember there is only one plant left, and there won't be any more stock before school starts."
"Excuse me, teacher."
[Master Zhuang]: "Okay, come to my office after you get it. I just have something to ask you."
Seeing the word 'office', Lin Ye couldn't help but take a deep breath, feeling a little nervous for no reason.
"Okay, teacher."
Close Chaoxin, open the shopping platform again, and search for ‘white tin powder’.
Not long after, Lin Ye frowned as he looked at the pictures on the phone screen.
‘Silver tin powder? ’
‘If I remember correctly, normal white tin powder should be off-white, right? ’
